description.en:
IBN MASAWAIH, or Ibn MXsoya (Mesua 
in Latin translations of the middle ages), AbU 
ZakarIya Yuhanna (Yahya), a Christian physician, whose father was a druggist at EjundeshSpur.
description.tr: [İBN MESEVEYH] İBN MESEVEYH, Ebû Zekeriyyâ Yuhannâ (Yahyâ), Hıristiyan hekim, babası Cündişâpûr'da eczacıydı.
